instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/arm_single.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/arm_single.step. Copy the single arm around Z into three arms spaced by 120 degrees, with the inner ends coincident, and fuse them into a three-spoke hub. Then cut a central through hole of diameter 12 mm. The final geometry must be the single fused hub. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
